_doc: Dear ImGui 1.90.8 (docking) parameters where NULL is a legal argument although imgui.h gives them no NULL default. tools/null_check_audit.py counts an exported pointer parameter that reaches one of these slots as NULLABLE-BY-API, and tools/harden-cimgui.py leaves it unguarded, so the two read one list and cannot disagree. A guard here would be the bug: FocusWindow(NULL) clears the focus, PushFont(NULL) pushes the default font, MenuItem's p_selected may be NULL. Every entry names where ImGui handles the NULL (imgui.cpp, imgui_widgets.cpp, imgui_draw.cpp, imgui_internal.h at 1.90.8). 'names' apply to a parameter of that name in any ImGui function; 'params' to one function's parameter (callee = the qualified name libclang gives, param = the name in imgui.h / imgui_internal.h).

names.reason: Begin / BeginPopupModal / BeginTabItem / CollapsingHeader: NULL means no close button (imgui.cpp Begin: if (p_open != NULL) ...)
PushID / GetID(const void*): the pointer's value is hashed as an ID, never read through
callback user data: handed back to the caller's own callback untouched
